question: Who was honoured with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mithun Chakraborty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** is India’s highest award in cinema, named after **Dadasaheb Phalke**, regarded as the "Father of Indian Cinema."
 
• The award was instituted in **1969** and is given annually at the National Film Awards ceremony organized by the Directorate of Film Festivals.
 
• It honors individuals for their outstanding contribution to the growth and development of Indian cinema. *Hence, it is a prestigious award.*
 
• **Mithun Chakraborty**, a renowned actor, was honored with the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** in **October 2024** for his extraordinary contribution to Indian cinema.
